visualCharacteristics.structure: eyebrow + large h2 statement; What you'll love list (authored items + shared fragment), Color information (LRV, RGB, HEX from metadata), Why Behr paint? (fragment, accordion on mobile); Add to project pill
visualCharacteristics.layout: stacked on mobile; 12-column grid with three 3-column info columns (1-3, 5-7, 9-11) from 1024px; CTA below the columns

contentPattern: Rows: [p eyebrow + h2 statement] / [optional cells: ul or paragraphs of color-specific 'What you'll love' items]. Loads /fragments/color-details/premium-color-detail/color-summary-what-youll-love and the color-detail-description-fragment metadata path (default /fragments/color-details/why-behr-paint). Reads lrv, color-r/g/b, rgbhex, color-code, color-name metadata.
